name: hug: a 40 px text plus 10 px left and right padding makes a 60 px frame
fixed: the frame keeps its size whatever its children need
fill: children share the space left after padding, gaps and fixed siblings
fill across the flow stretches to the frame's inner height
fill on an axis the frame hugs has nothing to fill: the child keeps its size
min width: a fixed child is never narrower than its minimum
max width on a fill child: it stops at its max and the other fill child takes the rest
max width on a hugging frame: it hugs up to its max
min height on a hugging frame: it hugs, but never below its min
a hugging text wider than its max width wraps at the max
a text filling the width wraps and its hugging frame grows to its new height
padding: space between the frame's edge and its children, per side
a fixed frame is never smaller than its padding: it sizes up to fit
the padding floor wins over a max size
an empty hugging frame is its padding plus its included inside stroke
strokes included: the frame's inside stroke takes up space like padding
strokes excluded: the stroke takes no space
center strokes are never counted, even when strokes are included
outside strokes are never counted, even when strokes are included
individual inside stroke weights count per side
fill children share the space inside padding and the included stroke
gap: a fixed distance between children; a hugging frame includes it
negative gap: children overlap by the gap
vertical gap: the same along y
auto gap between: as far apart as possible, no space at the edges
auto gap evenly: equal space in every gap and at both edges (1:1)
auto gap around: gaps twice the edge space (2:1)
auto gap stops at 0 when the children don't fit (no overlap)
auto gap evenly stops at 0 too (children start at the edge)
a single child of auto gap between aligns to the start (left)
a single child of auto gap evenly has equal space on both sides
auto gap with fill children: they take the free space, leaving no gap
align top left (the default)
align center: centered on both axes
align bottom right
vertical flow: main alignment is vertical, cross alignment horizontal
alignment works inside the padding
a hugging frame has no extra space: alignment changes nothing visible
auto gap keeps the cross alignment (top / center / bottom)
text baselines: texts of different sizes sit on one baseline
baseline alignment: a layer without text puts its bottom on the baseline
baseline alignment: a layer taller than the baseline moves the text down
baseline alignment without text: the layers' bottoms line up
horizontal wrap: left to right, a new row when the width runs out
vertical wrap: top to bottom, a new column when the height runs out
vertical wrap is not masonry: a column fills to the height before the next starts
wrap: auto gap spreads each row on its own
wrap: cross alignment within each row
ignore auto layout: the child keeps its place and the frame hugs only the flow
absolute children follow their constraints when the frame resizes (right / bottom)
absolute children follow their constraints (left and right / center)
fill tracks share the space by fr: 1fr and 2fr take a third and two thirds
fixed tracks keep their size; fill tracks share the rest after gaps and padding
hug tracks keep the smallest size around their children
fr tracks behave like the CSS fr unit: a fixed child taller than its share keeps its row
fr tracks: children bigger than every share keep their sizes (the grid overflows)
fr columns: a fixed child wider than its share keeps its column
placement: left to right, top to bottom; rows grow to fit the children
gap between columns and between rows
a child spanning two columns fills both and the gap between them
a child anchored to a cell sits there; the rest flow around it
children align in their cells (the frame's alignment)
a child aligns independently in its cell (its own alignment wins)
a hugging grid keeps the smallest size around its tracks (fill tracks hug too)
padding: the space between the frame's edge and its cells
